title: Identification of the section-normalized system compositor
statement: Fix a prime l and a finite extension E/Q_l. For any Operations presentation o and section-normalized Compositors c, composable scheme maps f:X→Y, g:Y→Z and any M in coefficientSequenceDerived l E Z, let d_h=eqToIso(sequence_derived_eq l E h) for h=f,g,fg. Then c.pullComp(f,g)(M);d_f(P_g M);P_f^ambient(d_g M) = d_fg(M);derivedComp_ambient(f,g)^(-1)(M). Thus the published compositor is the inverse ambient compositor under the specified functor equalities. No tensor comparison occurs in this statement. proof.text: Use sequence_direct_eq to present the ordinary direct images, their chosen left adjoints and the specified adjunctions on the common ambient functors. Compose the hom of the published ordinary direct compositor with the hom of ambient pushComp. By c.sections and the defining section formula of pushComp_existsUnique, this is restriction first along baseComp.hom and then along baseComp.inv. Presheaf functoriality and the inverse equations give the identity. Sectionwise extensionality identifies the published ordinary direct compositor with ambient pushComp.symm.

ConjugateEquiv injectivity and c.conjugate identify c.ordinaryPull with ambient comp.symm. The exact-functor factor equations mapDerivedCategoryNatIso_fac and mapDerivedCategoryCompIso_fac show that the localization of c.ordinaryPull satisfies c.pullComp_model. Cancel the invertible factorization maps and use Localization.natTrans_ext to identify c.pullComp with mapDerivedCategoryNatIso(c.ordinaryPull) followed by mapDerivedCategoryCompIso. Localization preserves inverse isomorphisms, so this is ambient derivedComp.symm. Under the common presentation the specified eqToIso functor comparisons are identities, giving the stated equation at M.

theorem publishedSystemCompositorIdentification
    (o : IntegralSystemRealization.Operations l E)
    (c : IntegralSystemRealization.Compositors l E o)
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (M : coefficientSequenceDerived l E Z) :
    let a : pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E (f ≫ g) ≅
        pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E g ⋙ pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E f :=
      c.pullComp f g
    a.hom.app M ≫
        (WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientPullIso l E f).hom.app
          ((pullbackTensorSequenceDerived l E g).obj M) ≫
        ((publishedSystemAmbientData l E).pull f).map
          ((WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientPullIso l E g).hom.app M) =
      (WeilConjectures.publishedSystemAmbientPullIso l E (f ≫ g)).hom.app M ≫
        ((publishedSystemAmbientData l E).comp f g).inv.app M
